reports.author: Claude
reports.title: Adversarial audit of the Codex bake-off and the project
reports.question: Does Codex's 'keep ElevenLabs' survive a recount from raw JSON, audio measurement and a repo read?
reports.verdict: Yes, on the full lesson track only. On 25-second chunks the same engine lost 3 of 8 of Medi's mistakes. Clip 16, not 14, is the cleanest vocabulary-poisoning case. The report email could go out before the page was pushed (fixed today).

numbers.label: Amal's typed forms in the Doc

reports.bars_title: Learner mistakes kept, out of 8 (gap, false start, stumble, malformed form, drill, dropped ع, gender slip, word choice)

reports.author: Codex
reports.title: Overnight bake-off: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe and CrisperWhisper 2.0
reports.question: Can Gemini, xAI, Inworld, Fish, StepAudio, Cartesia or a local model beat ElevenLabs on the same 20 frozen clips?
reports.verdict: No. Gemini's best arm found 14 of 20 target families but inserted a word the audio did not support. CrisperWhisper kept fillers but lost most targets and looped on 4 of 40 clips. xAI is the best untested option.
reports.bars_title: Target word families found, out of 20 clips (surface presence, not accuracy)

reports.author: Codex
reports.title: Fish Audio: research and test status
reports.question: Is Fish Audio's cheap ASR worth Amal's audio?
reports.verdict: Not now. Its API has no vocabulary, verbatim, speaker or word-timing controls, its terms allow training on uploads, and it costs more than ElevenLabs. Test only with Amal's informed consent.
reports.bars_title: Verbatim benchmark, English, filler F1 (Nyra Labs; interested party)

reports.author: Codex
reports.title: Full deep research: capture, engines, architecture, project audit
reports.question: What should Anees be built around, and does anything beat ElevenLabs?
reports.verdict: Build a better system around ElevenLabs, not a better engine: Ennuicastr separate tracks on Android, Scribe per track without keyterms, a 20-item Amal inbox. Speechmatics Melia tested and rejected as primary. Six P0 findings in the repo.
reports.bars_title: Fillers kept on the 20 clips (hesitation evidence)

reports.author: Codex
reports.title: Independent test: ElevenLabs vs OpenAI on 20 frozen clips
reports.question: Does a strict OpenAI prompt beat ElevenLabs at keeping Medi's words?
reports.verdict: No. The strict prompt fixed OpenAI's wrong-language habit but removed every filler and found fewer target families. Adding the vocabulary list to the prompt made it worse.
reports.bars_title: Target word families found, out of 20

reports.author: Claude
reports.title: Engine report: 14 engines on the Aug 25 lesson
reports.question: Which transcriber should Anees use for now?
reports.verdict: ElevenLabs Scribe v2 for now: Amal preferred it on 15 of 20 blind clips against Speechmatics and a local Whisper (OpenAI was not in that vote). It wins on words and hesitations kept, not on a human accuracy score.
